step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Matter's Verifier API solution on AWS. End users submit verifiable credentials (screenshots, PDFs, or photos) which are routed through an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB). ELB uses AWS WAF for request sanity checks (headers, content length) and AWS Shield Advanced for DDoS protection. Validated requests are routed to microservices running on Amazon EKS, which scales using Auto Scaling. Terraform is used to provision the infrastructure as code.

graph.name: Matter Verifier API Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for verifying digital identity credentials like the New Zealand My Vaccine Pass at scale using ELB, WAF, Shield Advanced, and EKS.
